name: kernel-development-skills
description: Linux kernel development the way experienced kernel engineers work: drivers, devicetree, Kconfig, debugging by symptom, testing, patch review and submission, regressions and bot reports, and stable, LTS, and vendor kernel trees.

interface.longDescription: Use Kernel Field Guide for Linux kernel work in any tree, the way experienced kernel engineers do it: driver code and teardown order, devicetree bindings and DTS, Kconfig, debugging by symptom (oopses, splats, hangs, no probe), KUnit and kselftest, patch review and submission with correct tags, regression and bot reports (syzbot, kernel test robot, KernelCI), and stable, LTS, Android, and vendor trees.
defaultPrompt: Plan and verify a Linux kernel driver change.
Review a devicetree binding and DTS update.
Debug a kernel CI or regression failure.
